result.title: Mamba3R: Fixed-Capacity Selective State Memory for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
result.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. The supplementary material referenced in the text is not included in this version
result.summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must maintain geometric quality over long inputs within a fixed GPU budget. A pretrained recurrent model provides bounded state, but freezing its backbone also fixes its learned state-observation interactions. We introduce Mamba3R, a jointly designed state-memory adapter that provides a trainable adaptation path without updating the backbone or task heads. A selective state-space mixer jointly transforms native state features and a fixed-capacity auxiliary memory, explicit read and write paths carry information across frames, and a decomposed feedback path regulates what the added memory feeds back. Only 1.28 million adapter parameters are trained. Under a shared periodic-reset protocol, it lowers trajectory error and improves accumulated surface and depth accuracy over recurrent baselines on public indoor and outdoor datasets and robot-recorded traversals, gaining up to 40 percent on one metric. Matched comparisons support both the choice of the mixing operator and the utility of carrying the auxiliary memory across frames. Allocated memory remains unchanged and throughput moves by at most 1.4 percent from one to two thousand frames. Replaying its recorded traversals offline, the platform's RTX 4060 averages 11.7 frames per second within 5.1 GiB with the same checkpoint, a mean throughput covering the 10 Hz sensor rate.

AI.brief_summary: Mamba3R 面向流式三维重建，在冻结预训练循环主干与任务头的前提下只训练约 128 万参数的选择性状态空间适配器，用固定容量辅助内存和显式读写路径跨帧传递信息，以在固定显存与吞吐约束下维持长序列几何质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其固定容量辅助内存、选择性混合与分解反馈门控可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何跨步保留视觉证据、容量受限时的信息坍缩以及长序列吞吐成本提供可核查的机制线索，但该文不做多模态推理，迁移价值需阅读后自行判断。
